title: No 10 condemns language used by Elon Musk at far-right UK rally as ‘dangerous’
summary: Comments follow remarks by Keir Starmer who is under pressure to be more proactive in defence of diversity UK politics live – latest updates Downing Street has fiercely condemned Elon Musk for using “dangerous and inflammatory” language, after he told a crowd of protesters in London that “violence is coming” and “you either fight back or you die”. Musk, the owner of X, opted to appear at the rally that left 26 police officers injured on Saturday, via a video link. He spoke to the activist Stephen Yaxley-Lennon, known as Tommy Robinson, while thousands watched and listened. Continue reading...

title: Trump threatens national emergency to force Washington DC police cooperation
summary: Mayor halted support for immigration enforcement after president’s 30-day police takeover ended US politics – live updates Donald Trump on Monday threatened to again take control of Washington DC ’s police department if the city did not cooperate with his plans for mass deportations of undocumented immigrants. The president’s threat came days after the expiration of a 30-day takeover of the Washington Metropolitan police department (MPD), which Trump ordered in response to his claim that the capital was experiencing an “out of control” crime wave. He also ordered in national guard troops and federal agents, who remain present in the city. Continue reading...
